output.subject: Your mobile app sign-in issue
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for calling us about the trouble you had getting into the mobile app. You told us you had been locked out since an app update on 9/10, and that the one-time passcodes needed to sign in were going to an old phone number rather than your current one. We're sorry for the frustration and inconvenience of being unable to reach your account through the app.

During your call, our representative confirmed your identity and updated the phone number on your profile, and you were able to log in while still on the line. We're glad you were able to get back in, and we want to make sure we fully understand what you experienced.

Our Digital Banking team will review what you told us about the update and the passcodes, and we will respond within 10 business days. If you have any further trouble signing in before then, or if passcodes don't reach your updated number, please get in touch with us.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Confirm the customer can still log in and that passcodes now reach the updated number.
Check why passcodes went to the old number after the 9/10 update and whether other customers were affected.
Decide whether a follow-up reply is still needed, since access was restored during the call.
Confirm the 9/10 date refers to the app update the customer described.
The call note contains date of birth, SSN verification and a phone number; none were included in the reply, so keep them out when editing.
